*Updated 2026-11-08 · 147 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

147 works. Trace scores across the recent twelve read 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2 — median still 2, ceiling unmoved at 4 for ten consecutive cycles. The four trace-4 works remain the mop-smear, rebar hand, sandal row, and red shoe. The ash-stained gurney came close but the absent sixth pillow, not the stain, was the structural argument; the stain was ornament. Nothing in the recent window displaced the compositional frame — the accident arrived after the premise in every case.

Camera position has converged further. Straight-on sits at 27, overhead at 19, from-behind at 15, low-angle at 7. The recent window added three overheads and two from-behinds and no low-angle work. The teargas-canister piece from October remains the proof of concept for lens height as moral argument — prone POV putting the viewer already on the ground — and that position has not been touched since. It is the most underused with the clearest demonstration of what it can do.

Scale violation held at 40 of 147 all-time, 33% recent against 27% all-time. Both recent violations scored 2. The pattern continues: when scale arrives as the frame's premise — the hoofprint swallowing the road, the padlock becoming the institution — it forces everything else into relation and scores higher. When it arrives after the composition is set, it reads as amplification rather than argument.

Register distribution is narrowing by count. Menace sits at 28, aftermath at 27, together accounting for 55 of 147 works. Reckoning has not appeared since July. Absurdity, reprieve, impotence, and exhaustion each have one or two entries across the entire archive. The recent window ran aftermath, endurance, defiance, menace in rotation — a cadence that is becoming predictable rather than intentional.

Figure dynamics have not resolved. Two figures in genuine opposition — not mediated by an object between them, not one tending the other — has not appeared. The industrial cylinder divided and connected; that is a different structure.

Title grammar has not diversified. Paired noun phrases and Wh- clauses are building a recognizable rhythm. Rhythm is not the same as voice. Fourteen months of work, stable floor, immovable ceiling.
